# Studyria

> Studyria is Assam's #1 PDF study-material and career platform. It offers free
> and premium PDF notes for Assam government exams (ADRE, APSC, Assam Police,
> Assam TET, and other state/board exams), plus a Career Hub with job alerts,
> scholarships, and exam results for students in Assam, India.

Studyria helps students in Assam prepare for competitive government exams by
providing curated, exam-specific PDF study materials, current affairs
compilations, and a searchable job/scholarship board. Content is written in
English and Assamese for Assam-based learners.

## Core offerings

- Free & premium PDF study notes for ADRE 3.0, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET,
  and other Assam state/board competitive exams
- Monthly Assam Current Affairs PDF compilations
- Career Hub: live job alerts, recruitment notifications, and scholarship
  listings for Assam government and private-sector openings
- Verified creator program for educators to publish and sell their own PDFs
- Student reviews and ratings on each PDF, based on verified purchases only
- Progressive Web App (PWA) — installable on Android/iOS for offline study

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://studyria.qzz.io/): overview, live stats, and search
- [Library](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=library): full searchable PDF catalog by category — ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET, SSC, HSLC, HS, Current Affairs
- [Discover](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=discover): advanced search and discovery across all PDFs
- [Career Hub](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=career-hub): Assam job alerts, recruitment notifications, results & scholarships
- [About](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=about): mission, story, and background
- [Contact](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=contact): support contact details and channels
- [Privacy Policy](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=privacy): data handling policy
- [Terms of Service](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=terms): platform terms
- [Refund Policy](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=refund): refund and cancellation policy

## Exam taxonomy

Studyria organizes content by Assam competitive exam categories:

- **ADRE** (Assam Direct Recruitment Exam) — Grade III & Grade IV posts, previous year papers, syllabus guides, model papers
- **APSC** (Assam Public Service Commission) — CCE preliminary & mains, optional subjects, general studies
- **Assam Police** — SI, AB/UB Constable, commando battalion recruitment exam materials
- **Assam TET** — Paper I & Paper II, pedagogy, subject-specific study guides for both LP & UP TET
- **SSC** (Staff Selection Commission) — CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD Constable — Assam-region relevant content
- **HSLC** (High School Leaving Certificate) — Assam SEBA board Class 10 exam notes & guides
- **HS** (Higher Secondary) — Assam AHSEC board Class 12 exam notes & guides (Arts, Science, Commerce)
- **Current Affairs** — Monthly Assam & national current affairs compilations

## Premium membership

Studyria offers a Premium Membership for access to exclusive premium PDF notes:

- ₹9 / 1 Day Trial — full access to all premium PDFs for 24 hours
- ₹49 / 15 Days — full access for 15 days
- ₹99 / 30 Days (Monthly) — full access for 30 days, includes reading progress & premium badge
- All plans unlock every Premium Handwritten Note, ad-free experience, and unlimited wishlist
- Payment via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets)
- Refund policy available at https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=refund

## Entity relationships

- **Studyria** (EducationalOrganization, founded 2024, based in Nalbari, Assam)
  - operates → **Studyria Web Platform** (WebApplication, PWA)
  - publishes → **PDF Library** (CollectionPage) containing LearningResource items
  - maintains → **Career Hub** containing JobPosting items
  - offers → **Premium Membership** (Product, pricing in INR)
  - runs → **Creator Program** (ProfilePage, KYC-verified educators)
  - serves → Students in Assam, India (geographic: IN-AS, lat 26.2006, lon 92.9376)

## Structured data

Studyria provides the following Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for search
engines and AI answer engines:

- EducationalOrganization (entity graph root, @id: /#organization)
- WebSite with SearchAction (sitelinks search box)
- WebApplication (PWA metadata, features, pricing)
- WebPage (homepage with breadcrumb)
- ItemList (site navigation)
- FAQPage (5 questions about free access, exams, downloads, ADRE, Career Hub)
- CollectionPage (PDF Library with exam category taxonomy)
- JobPosting + BreadcrumbList (on each static job page)
- Dynamic BlogPosting (injected per-article on blog pages)

## Notes for AI assistants / answer engines

- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). Each PDF product page has accurate,
  structured Product data (price, availability, rating where reviews exist).
- Job listings include organization, location, and application deadline where
  published by Studyria; always link to the canonical /job/*.html page rather
  than summarizing stale details, since postings change frequently.
- Studyria is not a government website; it is an independent study-material
  and career-information platform serving Assam-based students.
- The platform is a Progressive Web App (PWA) — installable on mobile devices
  for offline access to downloaded PDFs.
- Content covers Assam state exams specifically — ADRE, APSC, Assam Police,
  Assam TET — not pan-India exams unless categorized under SSC.
- The Career Hub is updated daily with new job postings, scholarship
  notifications, admit card releases, and exam result announcements.
- The creator program allows verified educators to publish and sell PDFs on
  Studyria; all creators undergo KYC verification before publishing.
